summary: CityPulse full-stack testing complete. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass covering auth, places, deals, favorites, planner (with/without AI, pinned/excludes, budget invariant, chronological steps), itineraries CRUD, stats and weather. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): login screen -> seeded token flow works; Discover screen loads 16 places, search ('chocolat' -> 1 result), category chip filter, list/map toggle (16 map pins) and place detail + favorite toggle verified; Deals screen loads, flash filter + QR sheet shows a CP-XXXX code (deal-qr-code-value); braderie deal correctly shows NO QR (qr_count=0); Planner generates results with AI title ('Tours gourmande/douceur et gourmandise...'), economics card (coût total/plein/bons plans/reste), chronological timeline, swap button changes step 0 (Chocolatière -> Beaux-Arts), régénérer and enregistrer work; saved itinerary appears in Carnet de voyage, detail opens with timeline; Profile stats reflect saved data (8,80 € économisé, 1 journée, 1 QR promo), monthly chart renders, theme switch toggles, logout returns to login. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used). One benign React Native web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from an internal lib (reanimated/expo). Non-blocking but worth tracking.

action_items: Optional: silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by moving pointerEvents to style on any custom component (grep usage).
Note that logout deletes the Mongo session; re-seed test_session_citypulse before next automated run (handled during this run).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI 0.11x+ — consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
Pydantic schema: PlanIn.excludes uses dict[str, List[str]] with str keys that are later int-converted — fine, but worth validating in model.
ai_tips() uses hardcoded fallback — good; AI path with 25s timeout works and p95 ~5-8s.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows validated across runs; Metro web-preview occasional disconnects required re-runs but did not surface functional defects)

seed_data_creation: Re-seeded user_sessions upsert for session_token=test_session_citypulse after logout test. Cleaned up TEST_ itineraries, claims and favorites at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Bearer test_session_citypulse (user_test001). Frontend env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) -> https://day-planner-243.preview.emergentagent.com. localStorage key cp_session_token JSON-stringified. Logout test deletes session in DB — upsert mongosh user_sessions with expires_at future before next run. Tab labels: 'Découvrir', 'Bons plans', 'Organiser' (not 'Organisateur'), 'Profil'. Prefer URL navigation (/deals, /planner, /journal, /profile) over clicking text labels to avoid conflict with filter chip 'Bons plans'.
rca_of_issue: None — no defects. Minor automation friction only (Metro web preview occasionally disconnects causing selector timeouts; worked around with URL navigation + longer waits).
